purpose: single exploratory pilot; cannot repair formal literal/category evidence shortage
training_rows: unambiguous train primary rows only; exclude scripted fixtures and whole rows with unsupported/invalid aggressive ownership or any null feature; retain and report all exclusions
labels: fixture final generator accepted partitions projected to the current tone prefix; labels never act as displayed history; exclude ambiguous top-one labels
pairs: one exact gold candidate versus each capped non-gold strict/literal candidate at a tone; missing gold events are recorded and excluded from objective, not recall denominators
objective: balanced-intent, equal-row, equal-tone, equal-negative pairwise logistic loss plus L2/2 * sum(w_i^2), i !=12
algorithm: float64 full-batch gradient descent; zero initialization; 200 iterations; learning rate0.05; L2=0.001; no early stopping; stable logaddexp logistic derivative; coefficient12 reset0 after every update
ordering: SHA256(seed+LF+fixture_id) rows ascending, event ascending, candidate identity UTF8 ascending
dev_selection: lexicographically minimize dev primary literal-conversion incidence, harmful-revision incidence, Chinese first-boundary error incidence, unnecessary-revision incidence, then margin ascending; all counts use fixed primary rows; no test selection
replay: pure causal Machine; generate fresh features from own frozen context; feature12 compares own actual prior shown; coefficient12=0; second-tone compatible-extension incumbent and strict >margin change rule; no compatible extension freezes old partition and appends literal bytes
ties: exact float64 equality only; score sum index0..25; prefer current compatible display, legacy exact-equivalent if mapped, firstChinese offset ascending (literal infinity), identity UTF8 ascending
evaluation: dev for exactly8 declared margins; freeze coefficients and selected margin; one final test replay; report primary, row and category counts, failures and unavailable paired metrics
numerics: NumPy float64 pinned runtime; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; ranked score accumulation uses Go float64 in feature-index order; nonfinite model scores abort
